name: find_schools
description: List schools in a city, optionally filtered by level and school type. Returns ids to pass to the other tools.

city.description: City name, for example Seattle or Jacksonville

name: get_school_facts
description: Profile facts for one school (type, grades, address, ratings, programs, after-school care, admissions). Each fact names its source field.

name: estimate_school_cost
description: Tuition and the Florida scholarships a family may qualify for at one school, with official links. Never promises an award amount.

name: define_term
description: Plain-language definition of a school term such as CTE, charter school, ESA, or summary rating.
